items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 15:1
items.html: (To the question) What is a long aspect? Length means the aspect of Hochma. And the NHY of Ima, at the time they are the garments of the Mochin of birth, namely when they are in the illumination of Hochma, are discerned as a long aspect. (Item 30).
